name: striking_environment
grain: one pre-fight fighter state row for each participant in each canonical UFC target fight

rules.rate_denominator: domain-specific observed exposure seconds from fighter-state primitives
rules.share_coverage_rule: Cross-domain shares/ratios are emitted only when the relevant observed exposure seconds are equal; otherwise null.
rules.zero_denominator_rule: Rates, accuracies, defenses and ratios are null when their denominator is zero or missing.
rules.defense_formula: 1 - opponent_landed / opponent_attempted on the same observed domain coverage

deferred_from_family_a_v0.early_knockdown_rate: requires round-specific historical state; implement with cardio/persistence round layer
deferred_from_family_a_v0.late_knockdown_rate: requires round-specific historical state; implement with cardio/persistence round layer
deferred_from_family_a_v0.defensive_pace_suppression: requires opponent expectation and belongs in Feature Family H opponent adjustment
deferred_from_family_a_v0.damage_creation_proxy: no arbitrary composite weights are authorized before a separately documented proxy definition and baseline audit
